description: The shipped de pack forms, discounts and releases a provision, and the figure lands in `P.B Rückstellungen` — the § 266 Abs. 3 B. position that was missing from the German balance sheet until 2026-08-29, on the same day its counterpart on the assets side arrived. Two things this fixture pins about the SHIPPED pack rather than about the mechanism. First, the accounts and their counter-accounts are the German ones: 3600 carries the provision, 6800 the addition, and a release goes to 4900 (sonstige betriebliche Erträge) — because a released provision is income the business never had to pay, and § 277 Abs. 4 HGB asks for no separate line. Second, and this is the decision worth reading: the de pack declares that provisions with more than twelve months to run are discounted (§ 253 Abs. 2 HGB) and it does NOT declare a rate. The rate is an average of the last seven years that the Bundesbank publishes monthly; a number sitting in a pack file would be stale before anybody upgraded it, and a stale legal rate that looks authoritative is worse than an absent one. So the pack carries the rule with its citation, the caller carries the rate, and a long-dated provision without one is refused by name instead of being booked undiscounted.

expect.comment: Fünf Jahre Restlaufzeit: das ausgelieferte Pack verlangt Abzinsung und liefert bewusst keinen Satz
Sechs Monate: unter der Grenze, keine Abzinsung — und der Aufwand geht laut Pack auf das Personalkonto, nicht auf 6800
Die Rückstellungen stehen als eigene Hauptposition da, wo § 266 Abs. 3 B. sie verlangt
Die Zuführungen treffen zwei verschiedene GuV-Zeilen, weil das Pack zwei verschiedene Aufwandskonten nennt
